title: Tailr Core translation index
description: translations/index.json of a translation source for Tailr Core.

$schema.description: The JSON schema of this file, for completion in your editor.

name.description: Name of the source, e.g. Tailr.

code.description: Language code, e.g. de, fr or pt-BR.

file.description: The translation file, relative to index.json, e.g. de.json.

version.description: Version of the translation, e.g. 1.0.0. Raise it with every change: Tailr Core shows an update when it is higher than the installed one.

name.description: Name in the language menu, e.g. "Deutsch". Default: "name" in the file.
